name: Anger the Skies: deal 3 (4 with Class Bonus) damage to all allies
notes: Anger the Skies is ARCANE, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real ARCANE champion (Lorraine, Arclight Saber) to unlock element access -- this grants a lineage-inherited 'Enlighten' fast-action ability, offered as an opportunity to both players once reserve is paid (same side effect documented for arcane-sight-level-draw); both decline. Unconditional base deals 3 damage to all allies both sides (GeneratedMacroCode.php ~22858-22865); the [Class Bonus] bump to 4 is out of scope. A Dungeon Guide seeded on the opponent's field takes lethal damage and lands in their graveyard, proving the effect fired.
